scope: Independent bounded audit of the four completed seed29 GPU conditions from the synced local artifacts. Only experiments/review/active-results-audit.json is written. Extended with bounded seed43 observed-only confirmation closure; the prior four-condition audit was not rerun.

conclusion.confirmation_scope: Seed43 observed-query random/oracle confirmation is complete and independently checked from local receipts. It failed qualification; no promotion and the recipe is closed.

execution_and_budget.initialization_scope: Full trainable-adapter tensor hashes in the runtime receipts, not a hash of all base-model tensors.

data_and_evaluation.posterior_check: Evaluated the declared 88 rule specifications independently and used exact integer likelihood weights 9**matching_observations. No hidden label was used in posterior calculation.
data_and_evaluation.fit_scope: Fit is measured on the 48 queried observations per stage, including repeats and observed noise; it is not fit to all posterior-generated training rows.

independent_bootstrap.method: Built a four-column correctness matrix from paired raw rows. Grouped row indices by device and input modulo 32 in first-occurrence order. With random.Random(29), drew each device's original number of causal groups with replacement using independent randrange calls. Retained every nuisance row in each selected group, computed the four accuracies within each device, averaged the five device values equally, and applied each contrast. Used statistics.quantiles with n=40 and method=inclusive for the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles.
independent_bootstrap.scope: Descriptive paired causal-group sampling uncertainty for these five fixed devices and one training seed; intervals are unadjusted for the five contrasts and do not establish training-seed robustness.

interpretations.observation: Observed replay: oracle accuracy 60.3125% versus random 55%, effect +5.3125 percentage points, interval [-4.6902, 16.4968].
interpretations.implication: The prescribed point gates pass, so the observed-only seed43 confirmation is consistent with the frozen protocol. The seed29 interval includes both harm and benefit, so this is not an established positive effect.

interpretations.observation: Posterior replay: oracle accuracy 65.9375% versus random 54.6875%, effect +11.25 points, interval [2.8187, 20.3390].
interpretations.implication: This descriptive acquisition contrast cannot qualify posterior consolidation: random stage0 ledger fit is 54.1667% below 75%; oracle new-skill gain is 4.6875 points below 5; oracle stable accuracy drops from 100% to 81.25%, violating the 5-point absolute limit; its retention change is also 32.8125 points worse than random.

interpretations.observation: Posterior-minus-observed effect is -0.3125 points for random and +5.625 points for oracle; the interaction is +5.9375 points. All three corresponding intervals include zero.
interpretations.implication: The four-condition results do not establish a beneficial consolidation effect or an acquisition-by-consolidation interaction.

interpretations.observation: Observed oracle new-skill accuracy rises from 29.6875% immediately before stage1 to 50% after stage1; observed random and posterior oracle also finish at 50%. The unadapted base new-skill accuracy is 46.875%.
interpretations.implication: The observed oracle's 20.3125-point new-skill gain partly reflects recovery from the stage0-adapted baseline. It passes the declared relative gain gate, but final accuracy is at balanced binary chance and does not establish new-skill proficiency.

baseline_and_frozen_base_evidence.frozen_probe_implementation: run.py:70-82 hashes each parameter name, shape, first two values and last two values. It samples base tensors; it is not a full base-tensor hash.
baseline_and_frozen_base_evidence.runtime_evidence: Both executions finish successfully with the recorded run.py hash. That path freezes the base, rejects frozen-parameter gradients, and checks the sampled base probe after fresh loads and adapter unload. The initial base and all four eval-before-stage0 prediction artifacts are exactly equal across all 304 rows; base-stage1 artifacts match across runs on 400 rows.
baseline_and_frozen_base_evidence.limits: These are sampled weight checks plus equality of recorded baseline outputs. No full frozen-base tensor equality proof is saved, and none is inferred. Random and known-family oracle acquisition use zero model-scoring input tokens in these runs; a general learned active selector is not tested.

checkpoint_reload_evidence.probe_scope: All four probes are stable device0, context0, target0; the same four inputs are used at both stages. Exact logit equality is scoped to these probes.
checkpoint_reload_evidence.limits: Adapter tensors and optimizer files were not part of the bounded local sync. The saved hashes and successful GPU reload receipts are internally consistent, but this audit did not independently rehash those remote tensor files or reload a model. Optimizer loading succeeds in the source path; an exact optimizer-state equality assertion is not recorded.

prior_seed17.interpretation: The earlier screen remains negative: model uncertainty -8.75 points and known-family oracle -1.5625 points against random. This follow-up does not replace that result.

confirmation_closure.independent_calculation: Computed forced-choice accuracy, new-skill gain and stable change directly from prediction rows. Rebuilt paired correctness columns, sampled causal input groups within each device using random.Random(43), and obtained percentile bounds with statistics.quantiles(n=40, method=inclusive). No parent analysis function was imported.
confirmation_closure.bootstrap_scope: Descriptive causal-group sampling uncertainty within one confirmation seed; not a joint estimate of training-seed uncertainty and not pooled with seed29.

baseline_and_reload_limits.limit: Existing sampled frozen-base, narrow logit-probe and local checkpoint-file limits remain in force. Completion and consistent receipts establish successful runtime assertions, not an independent full-base tensor comparison or a new model reload by this reviewer.

decision.conclusion: The observed-label acquisition effect does not clear the 5-point minimum effect or new-skill learning gates at seed43. Zero stable forgetting in this failed acquisition regime is not evidence of successful continual learning. No confirmed active-acquisition benefit under this recipe; preserve the seed17 negative and seed29 factorial results and close the recipe without further AE runs.
